verdict.rationale: Customer.io documents a 'Customer.io AI' capable of building automations, drafting messages, and analyzing performance (docs-1, docs-16), with a Slack-based assistant interface (docs-20) and AI-generated design features (docs-15), suggesting some built-in assistant functionality. However, most detailed evidence describes this AI working through an external MCP server/CLI-skills setup (docs-2, docs-9, docs-10, probe-3) rather than a fully native in-product chat assistant, and there's no independent/hands-on confirmation of its reliability. Missing for 10: clear documentation of a native in-app assistant UI (vs. MCP/CLI-only access), and third-party corroboration of task delegation working well.
